writeup: Woot has relisted the OtterBox Sole Series case for the Samsung Galaxy S26 in Real Quiet Blue or Xtra Hot Pink for $4.99, a drop from the earlier $6.99 listing. This is the fabric-back shell with a removable finger loop and built-in magnets for fast charging. OtterBox's own site currently sells the same Blue and Pink Sole Series cases for $41.99, and SHI lists the blue at $54.99, so this is 88% and about $37 below the lowest verified store price. Stock is thin, with 3+ left and a limit of 3 per customer.
